outcome: Endocrine and metabolic morbidity in offspring (hospitalizations up to age 18)
cohort: All singleton-term deliveries (n=131,880) occurring between 1991 and 2014 at a single tertiary medical center
finding: Elective cesarean delivery was not independently associated with long-term pediatric endocrine and metabolic morbidity after adjusting for maternal obesity.
mod_finding: While the unadjusted analysis showed a higher cumulative incidence of endo-metabolic morbidity in offspring born via CD, after adjusting for maternal obesity, CD was not an independent risk factor.
